name: deals
description: Find deals in a Deals account, through an app Kivali builds and installs there.

tools.name: find_deals
tools.description: Search the account's deals by name. Reads only.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Name the account the app is installed on, for Test connection. Reads only.

setup.summary: Builds a private app in your Deals account with the scopes agents need, installs it there, and keeps its token. The setup key you paste is used once and kept nowhere.

setup_key.title: Setup key
setup_key.words: A one-time setup key, from Settings, Developer, Setup keys, in your Deals account.

token.title: App token
token.words: The app's token, from its page in Deals, under Show token.

keeps.token: The app's token, which every call sends

app_id.words: The app's id in Deals, to rebuild or remove it
